name: typos-format
description: Auto-fix spelling typos on edit via typos-cli, unconditionally — honoring the consuming repo's own typos configuration when one is present. Cursor note: on-edit automation is a Claude Code plugin hook (hooks/hooks.json). Cursor's documented Claude hook compatibility loads from .claude/settings.json (third-party hooks), not this plugin's hooks.json; this export ships an empty Cursor-native hooks stub. Skills and agents still load.
